name: dsh-computer-use
description: Computer Use: desktop observation and background actions, isolated browser DOM/ref tools, policy-checked batch workflows

permissions.summary: 桌面通过cua-driver观察/操作，可显示本机DSH状态面板及停止按钮；浏览器可选独立Playwright，或经用户安装的Chrome扩展在当前登录Chrome的专属标签分组中可见操作。扩展仅接管本次新建并登记的标签，用户移出分组或点击停止即撤销；不读取Cookie/历史数据库。Chrome扩展模式暂不提供自动上传/下载，独立模式文件传输仍走宿主授权与审批。
commands: Optional local Chrome Native Messaging companion
Optional local Swift/AppKit status panel helper
writePaths: Explicit browser_download directory, restricted by host sandboxPolicy (new files only)
Explicitly installed Chrome NativeMessagingHosts manifest and DSH-owned launcher/socket
permissions.externalServices: User-requested http/https pages in isolated Chrome; optional configured Z.AI GLM vision API
permissions.failureBoundaries: cua-driver 缺失 → 结构化错误含自救指引；危险操作或前台键盘/文本重试未获用户审批 → 明确拒绝原因且不执行重试；观测快照过期 → 拒绝执行并提示重新观测；GLM key 未配置或请求失败 → 视觉 fallback 返回明确错误，不影响 AX/native 路径；超时 → 超时错误

scripts.check: node tools/check.mjs && npm run lint && npm run format:check
